  60| // mapVectorMetricToEmbListMetric maps element-level vector metrics to EmbList-level metrics for ArrayOfVector.
  61| // Autoindex configs use element-level metrics (e.g., IP, L2, COSINE), but ArrayOfVector fields
  62| // require EmbList metrics (e.g., MaxSimIP, MaxSimL2, MaxSimCosine).
  63| func mapVectorMetricToEmbListMetric(metricType string) string {
  64| 	switch strings.ToUpper(metricType) {
  65| 	case strings.ToUpper(metric.COSINE):
  66| 		return metric.MaxSimCosine
  67| 	case strings.ToUpper(metric.L2):
  68| 		return metric.MaxSimL2
  69| 	case strings.ToUpper(metric.IP):
  70| 		return metric.MaxSimIP
  71| 	case strings.ToUpper(metric.HAMMING):
  72| 		return metric.MaxSimHamming
  73| 	case strings.ToUpper(metric.JACCARD):
  74| 		return metric.MaxSimJaccard
  75| 	default:
  76| 		return metricType
